args.title: Café site within 1 km of Parramatta station, ranked by profit
args.verdict: Near Parramatta (-33.81751, 151.006049) ranks first by 36-month profit: $814k, with a 5.3% chance of a 36-month loss. It wins on demand (about 14,700 potential customers within walking distance), despite tougher competition. Its estimated rent is high at $16,415/month, and the profit range is wide ($127k to $1.55M P10-P90), so treat this as a shortlist ranking rather than a revenue forecast.

key_numbers.label: Runner-up: Near Robin Thomas profit / loss chance
Near Church Street profit / loss chance

reasons: Highest profit of the 12 candidates re-run with the full model; ranked #1 in 99.7% of simulations.
About 14,700 potential customers within walking distance (3,315 residents, 8,027 workers, 3,377 commuters), +52% vs the average candidate.
Six anchors within 250 m add a 1.17x foot-traffic boost; residents' age profile fits the café customer (x1.32).
Competition is heavier (70 competitors within 800 m, -17% vs average) but the site still wins the most demand.
risks: Estimated rent of $16,415/month is the largest cost; if the actual lease is higher, profit falls quickly. Run the what-if with the real rent.
Profit P10 is only $127k over 36 months, and the simulation used default wages ($26k/month) and other fixed costs ($2.5k/month). Check these against your own plan.
Model accuracy is not statistically proven against real café openings beyond plain foot traffic.
Opening is simulated for 1 Nov 2026, with a January seasonal low of about -22%.
next_steps: Get the actual asking rent for the Near Parramatta frontage and re-run simulate_sites with it.
Check foot traffic and competitor count on the ground at different times of day, especially the 70 competitors within 800 m.
Confirm the 35 approved developments in reach are actually going ahead.
Compare against Near Robin Thomas ($446k profit, lower rent of $8,793/month) if the Near Parramatta lease cost is too high.
